V9 English:
For a focused evaluation, choose 10 real products covering common and difficult shapes or materials. Set display requirements and compare outputs with the actual products.

Record accepted assets, retries, correction time and API cost. Include viewer and integration work when comparing the total effort with your current content process.

V10 English:
Choose 10 real products, including difficult shapes or materials. Agree on display standards, required export formats and viewer limits, including topology, polygon budget and UVs where relevant. Check shape, dimensions and materials against the originals.

Record integration hours; generation and retry costs; time to first approval; cleanup hours; viewer-check time; and accepted assets out of 10. Include viewer development when comparing total cost.

Leave your details to discuss scope and arrangements. Your team runs the test unless agreed otherwise.

Keep input sources, task IDs, settings, review decisions and final versions in your own project records, following your disclosure and review policies. Include ongoing integration maintenance in the cost comparison.
V10 中文:
选择10款真实产品，包含难处理的外形或材质。测试前确定展示标准、所需导出格式和查看器限制，包括适用的拓扑、面数预算及UV要求，再对照实物核对外形、尺寸和材质。

记录系统接入工时、生成及重试成本、首个输出通过验收所需时间、人工清理工时、查看器检查时间，以及10项资产中的通过数量。比较总成本时计入查看器开发。

留下联系方式，沟通范围及安排。除非另有约定，测试由你的团队执行。

在自己的项目记录中保留输入来源、任务ID、生成设置、审核决定和最终版本，并遵循自己的内容标注和审核要求；成本比较也需计入后续集成维护。
